description: Erected single storey outbuilding for playroom/Gym ( Retrospective )
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal, by reason of its size and siting, will result in an unreasonable degree of amenity impact on neighbouring properties, Nos. 27 &amp; 31 Boxtree Lane contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and policy GR1 of the emerging Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The proposal, by reason of the fact that application site already benefits from an existing rear extension, side garage, and shed in the rear in addition to the application outbuilding, it is also considered that the application outbuilding results in an unreasonable amenity impact to the existing and future occupiers of No 29 Boxtree Lane in their private enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse and rear garden. Therefore, the proposal is contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and policy GR1 of the emerging Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
